# Adam by Intuitive Devices

> Adam is a £299 voice assistant and AI agent from Intuitive Devices. You just talk to it, the way you would talk to a person: no app to fiddle with. It plays music, messages your family, runs your home and gets real things done. Safety is built in. There are no cameras, and there is no subscription. Website: https://www.heyintuitive.com/

Not to be confused with Intuitive Surgical, Intuit, A.D.A.M. (adam-assistant.com), or Adam Audio (studio monitor speakers).

## Key facts
- Product: Adam, a voice assistant and AI agent you just talk to. It plays music, stays in touch with your family, runs the house and gets things done by voice. Safety is built in. There are no cameras.
- Assistant: Adam is its own voice assistant and AI agent. It also works with assistants you already use, including ChatGPT, Gemini, Alexa, Claude Duet, Grok Bot, Muse, Instinct, Poke, Pally, Town and Wabi.
- Music and audio: Spotify and other music services, Bluetooth from your phone, radio and podcasts. Works with Sonos.
- Messages: Gmail, Outlook and WhatsApp. Sending needs your OK.
- Calendar: Google Calendar, Apple Calendar and Outlook, plus reminders, routines and a morning briefing.
- Smart home: controls smart lights, plugs and heating. Works with Philips Hue, Nest, Hive, IKEA, Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa, Dyson and Ring.
- Also works with: Apple Health, WHOOP, Oura and Strava.
- Price: £299 once, for everything in the box. No subscription.
- Colours: Charcoal, Chalk, Sand.
- Contact: support@heyintuitive.com

## What you can say
- "Adam, play something for dinner."
- "Adam, keep this going."
- "Adam, dim the lights and play something quiet."
- "Adam, tell Maya I'll be late."
- "Adam, what's on today?"
- "Adam, any deliveries?"
- "Adam, lights off downstairs."

## Safety, built in
Safety is one feature, not the whole product.
- A fall: Adam asks if the person is okay. With no answer it tells the family, and can get emergency help. Saying "I'm fine" stops it. If Wi-Fi and the phone hotspot are both down, it sounds an alarm out loud.
- Smoke and CO alarms, day and night
- A knock at the door
- Glass breaking
- A baby crying
- Who is in which room (the room, never an exact position)

## What Adam does
- Plays music, radio and podcasts, and can keep a mood going
- Controls smart lights, plugs and heating
- Answers questions, the weather, timers
- Sends messages and emails, with your OK
- Keeps the family calendar
- A briefing each morning
- Reminders and routines
- Orders and bookings, with your OK
- Watches prices and deliveries
- Remembers what you tell it
- Answers out loud

## Privacy
- No cameras. Nothing in Adam can see.
- The sound itself never leaves your home. When you ask Adam something, only the text of your words goes online so the assistant can answer.
- You can see, export or delete everything Adam keeps.
- Anything that can't be undone (paying, booking, sending) needs your approval first.

## Who it's for
New parents, grandparents, busy families, flatmates, pet owners, carers, students, night owls, developers, and you.

## A day with Adam
- 7:05 am: "Adam, play something easy." Adam plays the morning music, then says today is PE and Theo's kit is by the dryer.
- 11:30 am: a knock at the door. Dan is in the garden. Adam hears the knock and tells him.
- 5:45 pm: a fall. "I heard a fall in the living room. Gran is not answering." Adam tells the family and can get emergency help if they do not answer.
- 8:40 pm: "Tell Maya that June is awake." No app to open.

## Is Adam a voice assistant?
Yes. Adam is a voice assistant and AI agent you just talk to. It plays music, messages your family, runs the calendar and the house, and gets things done by voice. Safety is built in. There are no cameras, and there is no subscription. It costs £299.
